Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-circumscribed, homogeneous soft tissue opacity in the right paratracheal region that does not significantly displace adjacent structures, which is the classic radiographic appearance of a benign bronchogenic cyst. Other options describe locations (posterior, cardiophrenic, anterior) or features (irregular margins, calcification) that do not match the image or the typical presentation of a bronchogenic cyst.
